results: For every active component, base-ratio return is equivalent to the exact normalized source-derivation comparison, with no equal-constant-field hypothesis. A finite trace plus a finite-conjugate averaging lemma replaces finite-order telescoping.
The actual polynomial primitive-element return proves L0[y,z]=L[v]. A published Parallel Lines Lemma gives g=G-a and g0=minpoly_a(G), with G a coordinate over L0 and L=L0(a).

The base-compatible active factors are exactly the L-irreducible factors of g0. Their component ring is C_h[v_h]; their degree and ambient-to-target field index account exactly for enlarged constants.

The first tails have explicit first-order forms modulo the minimal source polynomial. These forms and the differential identities still allow the recorded formal residual branch, so they do not prove automatic compatibility.

For an actual sliced coordinate frame, projected-ring equality is equivalent to membership of the projected slice in A, and to the selected speed being a nonzero constant. A polynomial formal boundary shows why actualness cannot be replaced by the weaker projection and leading-LND data.

The two-recovery construction is an actual polynomial automorphism for arbitrary coupling, but its three-good condition forces the coupling to vanish under the stated nonlinear hypotheses, without a last-degree bound.
